name: Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord
description:
About This Game

In Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord, you'll immerse yourself in a fantasy world as a leader of a squad of the Circle of Unquenchable Thirst. Along with recruiting, leveling, arming, and providing for your army, you'll be in charge of your very own flying fortress. Growing it and improving its system will prove invaluable to challenges ahead.

Story:

After the tragic death of King Aurelius, Archbishop Marius approaches the Elder Undead Lords with the desire to strike a deal with them. Succumbing to temptation, Marius plans to obtain an artifact capable of giving the Inquisition an unlimited power. In return, he will help the lords capture the coveted Temple of Water. The Undead Lords accept the deal and so the Lord of Chaos enters the game.

You'll be able to create a unique squad, by recruiting new warriors with a multitude of skills and weapon preferences. The tasks that will be assigned to you will require not only the strength of your warriors, but also cunning. The search for valuable artifacts, raiding cities, subduing enemy commanders, desecrating lands, and capturing altars are only a few of the challenges you will face.

Every choice opens up opportunities. Change tactics and try new powers. In "Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord" all means are good to leave your mark on history, be it force, diplomacy, or magic! Your decisions will determine the fate of the kingdom.

  • A new single-player campaign centered around the undead armies and Chaos Lord, consisting of more than 30 missions, over 20 hours long.

  • Overall improved graphics and skeletal animations for all units.

  • Fight against members of 9 races and factions and their unique units. A total of over 50 different units divided into classes (warrior, assassin, support, rider, strongman) are available for use. We also introduce a brand new race: Forest Spirits (with the ability to play for it in free-to-play mode).

  • New tactical combat options such as: ZONE OF CONTROL, BACKSTAB.

  • Develop your fighters with the help of 6 levels and 15 talents (9 special talents and 6 class talents). Pick up equipment, weapons and elixirs for all occasions.

  • A complete overhaul of the controls.

  • Manage your own flying castle, fight enemy castles, unlock upgrades and develop its systems.

  • Battle in free-to-play mode for one of 5 available factions: humans, undead, orcs, elves, and forest spirits. Single-player or multiplayer over LAN with up to 2 players.
short_desc: In Stones Keeper II: Chaos Lord, you will find both the well-known game mechanics of the original game as well as many new features. A signature blend of RPG and strategy with turn-based tactical battles.
